2000.name: Entrance To The Draconian Encampment

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2000.description:
A palisade of sharpened stakes, lashed with rawhide and braced with
thornbrush, stretches away through the trees, and in the middle of it
the timber gate now stands open, its bar hauled aside. Beyond the gap
the open plains lie pale to the east. Westward the ground is beaten hard
and bare, and the smell of smoke and roasting meat hangs over the pines.
A skull on a pole beside the gate grins at all who pass.

extra_descs.skull pole:
The skull is that of a man, bleached and cracked, with a rag of red
cloth knotted through its eye socket as a warning.

2001.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Draconian Encampment.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2001.description:
The path is a stripe of packed earth, rutted by heavy feet, running
between stunted pines whose lower branches have been hacked off for
firewood. Gouges in the bark show where blades are tried on the trunks.
The gate lies back east, and the path forks here, one arm turning north
and the other running on west into the camp. A rack of broken spears
leans against a stump.

2002.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2002.description:
Three paths meet at a broad crossing where the earth is trampled to dust
by drilling feet. Clawed prints in orderly rows show where warriors have
formed ranks and wheeled. Stakes notched at intervals mark the distances
for spear-casting. The way north leads to a pot-hung hearth, the track
east returns toward the gate, and the path west leads deeper into the
camp.

2003.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies In the light.

down.description: To the down lies In The Dark.

2003.description:
A great split boulder stands where the path divides, its two halves
leaning apart like a cracked skull. To the west the trees open on a
patch of bright bare ground, while at your feet a black hole yawns where
the earth has fallen in, its rim worn smooth by hands and claws. A rope
runs down into it, tied to an iron peg. The path goes north toward a
rock face and east back toward the crossing.

extra_descs.hole pit rope peg:
The pit is a squared shaft cut into the earth and about three times a
man's height deep. The rope looks sound, and the dark at the bottom
gives back no echo.

2004.name: In The Dark

up.description: To the up lies A Trodden Path.

2004.description:
The dark is total, a heavy blindness smelling of old urine, wet clay and
long fear. Iron rings are set into the earth walls at head height, with
rusted shackles dangling from them. The floor is hard-packed and sticky
underfoot. A rope hangs down the shaft from the world above, the only
way out.

2006.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Tunnel.

2006.description:
On the west side of the path a low black opening has been cut into a
bank of rock and shored with rough timbers, and a tunnel leads away into
it. Shavings of wood and heaps of spoil lie before the mouth. The air
that comes out is cool and smells of wet stone. The path runs north
toward the huts and south to the split boulder.

2007.name: A Narrow Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Tunnel.

2007.description:
The daylight fades behind you as the tunnel leads inward, so low that a
tall man must stoop, propped every few paces by black timber props.
Chisel scars run along the rock in long shallow strokes. The air is cool
and still and smells of stone dust. The path lies back east, and the
tunnel goes on west.

2008.name: A Narrow Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Tunnel.

2008.description:
The props give out here and the walls are bare rock, glistening wet in
the light of a single torch in a bracket. A thin trickle runs along a
gutter in the floor and vanishes into a crack. Your steps echo flatly
ahead and behind. The tunnel runs on west and back east.

2009.name: A Narrow Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Tunnel.

2009.description:
The tunnel widens briefly into a bay where a pile of broken wedges and
rusted hammers has been tipped against the wall. A niche in the rock
holds a clay lamp, its wick burned to a black crust. Soot has smeared a
long dark streak across the roof. The passage continues west and back
east.

2010.name: A Narrow Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies End Of The Narrow Tunnel.

2010.description:
The tunnel squeezes in until your shoulders brush the walls, and long
claw-marks gouge the stone at the height of a man's chest. A faint
draught stirs from ahead and carries a tang of smoke. The rock is warmer
here than it has any right to be. East the way leads back toward the
entrance, and west it narrows to its end.

2011.name: End Of The Narrow Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Tunnel.

2011.description:
The tunnel ends in a wall of chiselled rock, flat and blank, where the
diggers must have given up or been called away. Rubble is heaped in a
drift across the floor, and a tally of scratches in groups of five
covers the wall as high as a hand can reach. Dull knocks from somewhere
deep in the stone are felt rather than heard. The only way back is east.

2012.name: A Trodden Path

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

2012.description:
A tripod of lashed poles stands over a ring of cold ashes, a big black
pot hanging from it by a chain. The grass round about is trampled flat
and strewn with gnawed ribs. A pile of kindling has been stacked against
a pine as high as a man. The path comes in from the east and turns
south.

2013.name: A Trodden Path

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2013.description:
The path bends round a clump of blackened stumps, the remains of a tree
that was burned for sport. A heap of charred bones lies by the wayside,
picked clean by something with strong teeth. Smoke drifts low through
the branches, bitter and greasy on the tongue. The track returns south
toward the gate and goes on west.

2014.name: A Trodden Path

east.description: To the east lies The Large Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2014.description:
The trees thin to stumps as the path nears the clearing, the felled
trunks dragged aside and left to rot in rows. Deep wagon ruts score the
mud, filled with brown rainwater. A tall pole at the verge flies a
tattered pennant of black and red. The Large Clearing opens east, and
the path leads back west among the huts.

2015.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2015.description:
A signal gong hangs from a gallows of crossed poles at a widening of the
path, its bronze dented and green. Bone dice lie scattered in the dust
where soldiers have gambled away their pay. The trees thin to the east,
where a trampled track runs out toward a clearing. The path goes north
among the huts and west back along the hut row.

2016.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Hut.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

2016.description:
A small hut of lashed timber and hide squats on the north side of the
path, its door-flap tied back. The ground in front is bare and swept,
with a row of lance-heads stuck point-down in the earth. A smell of
tallow drifts from the doorway. The path runs east toward a gong and
south to the tunnel mouth.

2017.name: A Small Hut

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

2017.description:
The hut is a single low room of lashed poles and stretched hide, hardly
high enough to stand in. A pallet of bracken lies against one wall
beside a chest with a broken lid. Smoke from a tiny fire-pit finds its
way out through a hole in the roof, leaving the air thick and acrid. The
doorway leads out south to the path.

2018.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2018.description:
Hides are stretched on frames along this stretch of the path, scraped
clean and drying in the smoke, with a sour smell of curing. A hut with a
roof of turf and bark sits to the west, its door a lashed hurdle. A
bucket by the door holds arrows with black fletching. The path runs
north and south.

2019.name: A Small Hut

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

2019.description:
A hut with two doors, one in the north wall and one in the east, both
hung with hides. Bedrolls are laid out in a row, each with a leather
helm placed carefully at its head. A smoky lantern gives a red wavering
light on the bare poles. The air smells of oil, sweat and old leather.

2020.name: A Trodden Path

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2020.description:
The path turns sharply here between two lean pines hung with strings of
knucklebones that rattle dryly in the smoke. The ground is churned by
cartwheels, and a broken axle lies half sunk in the mud. Charred timbers
show where a shed once stood. The path runs south and west.

2021.name: A Trodden Path

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2021.description:
The path ends in a trampled turning-place behind a hut, ringed by
kitchen scraps and the fly-buzzing mess of a refuse pit. Pegs hold a
line of grey rags to dry. A pair of black wings has been nailed to the
hut wall as a charm against ill luck. The only way on is west, through
the hut.

2022.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Hut.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Hut.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2022.description:
Two huts face each other across the path, one to the north and one to
the south, their roofs of turf and bark black with smoke. Between them
stands a post carved with ranks of grinning dragon heads, painted red. A
firepit is dug into the trodden earth and ringed with stones. The path
runs east and west.

2023.name: A Small Hut

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2023.description:
A cramped hut with walls of daubed wattle and a floor of beaten earth,
dry and warm. Racks of curved blades hang from the rafters on hooks, and
a whetstone sits on an upturned bucket. The roof is blackened by years
of smoke. A door south opens onto the path, and a low gap in the east
wall leads out to a muddy yard.

2024.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Abandoned Hut.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Hut.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2024.description:
Four ways meet round a rough square of packed earth, with a hut to the
south and one to the north whose roof has half collapsed. A well-worn
path leads east and west. Weeds push up through the cracked mud where
the troops no longer march. A broken spear stands in the ground with a
scrap of cloth hanging from it.

2025.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Hut.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Abandoned Hut.

2025.description:
A rack for drying meat stands in the middle of the path, hung with long
dark strips that buzz with flies. A hut sits to the north and a ruined
one to the south, the second leaning drunkenly on a prop. The ground
beyond is a tangle of thorn and fallen pine, and the only way back is
east along the trodden earth.

2026.name: A Small Hut

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Abandoned Hut.

2026.description:
This hut is cleaner than most, the floor swept and a neat stack of
rations in wicker baskets along the wall. A table of planks bears a clay
tablet scratched with a rough map, all ridges and notches. A low opening
in the west wall leads into the neighbouring hut. The door north gives
onto the path.

2027.name: A Small Abandoned Hut

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Hut.

2027.description:
Whatever lived here left in a hurry: a clay pot lies shattered by the
cold hearth, and a belt still hangs from a peg. Dust covers everything,
and a cobweb stretches from corner to corner of the low roof. A gap in
the east wall opens into the inhabited hut beside it, and the doorway
north looks out on the path.

2028.name: The Chief Guard's Hut

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

2028.description:
The chief's hut is the largest in the camp, its beams carved and its
walls hung with the scaled hides of old foes. A long table is spread
with maps drawn on hide, weighted down with daggers and a cracked skull.
A rack holds polished spears and a heavy two-handed sword, and a brazier
warms the room to stuffiness. The single door is north, to the path.

extra_descs.maps hides table:
The maps show the lands round the camp in rough strokes, with fords,
roads and farmsteads marked by small red crosses. Some of the crosses
have been struck through.

2029.name: A Small Abandoned Hut

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

2029.description:
Half the roof has fallen in, burying one corner under turf and
splintered poles. Scorch marks blacken the floor and one wall, as if
fire swept through here long ago and was never mended. A ring of stones
in the middle holds only damp ash. The doorway north is the only part
that still stands whole.

2030.name: A Small Hut

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2030.description:
A hut crowded with barrels and sacks, smelling of grain, salt fish and
tar. A tally stick hangs from a nail, notched in groups of five. The
ceiling is hung with ropes of dried onion. The door is south on the
path, and a gap in the west wall leads into a second hut.

2031.name: A Small Abandoned Hut

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

2031.description:
Rain has come in through a hole in the roof of this long-empty hut, and
the floor is a mat of rotting leaves and pale fungus. A pallet lies
against one wall, chewed to splinters by mice. The hide door has fallen
off its pegs and lies in the corner. Nothing here has been touched in
years, and the doorway is south.

2032.name: A Small Hut

east.description: To the east lies A Small Hut.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

2032.description:
This hut is a smithy of sorts: a stone anvil sits on a tree stump, and a
pair of goat-hide bellows hangs from a post beside a bed of cold coals.
Tongs, hammers and half-finished blades lie in untidy rows. Flakes of
rust litter the floor like russet leaves. The wall opens east into a
store, and a door south leads out to a path.

2033.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Hut.

south.description: To the south lies The Chief Guard's Hut.

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2033.description:
A fine hut of squared logs stands to the south, the only building here
with a proper plank door, and over it hangs a banner of black cloth
worked with a red dragon's head. Two spears are planted on either side
of the threshold. The ground before it is swept clean and edged with
white stones. The path leads west, and a hut lies to the north.

2034.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Abandoned Hut.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2034.description:
A crossing in the heart of the camp, where the ground is churned to
black mud by the passage of many feet. A hut stands to the west and a
derelict one to the south, its door fallen in. A rain barrel overflows
beside a sheltered fire. Paths run north and east.

2035.name: A Small Hut

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

2035.description:
This hut serves as a surgeon's den: rolled bandages fill a basket, jars
of foul-smelling salve crowd a shelf, and a table of boards with leather
straps stands stained and scrubbed. A kettle of herbs steams over a
little fire, thick with bitter vapour. Needles and gut hang from a nail.
The door is east, on the path.

2036.name: A Small Hut

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

2036.description:
A barracks for the rank and file: crude bunks are stacked three high
against the walls, with gear heaped in untidy mounds beneath them.
Charcoal drawings of dragons in flight cover the beams, some of them
quite skilful. A rope of knotted cords hangs from the rafters for
climbing practice. The door is east, onto the path.

2037.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies A Trodden Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2037.description:
A stand of old pines survives here, a few tall trees spared the axe,
with ropes slung between them and sacks of sand hanging from the ropes
where fists have beaten them smooth. The ground is scuffed into circles
by footwork. A hut sits to the west, and the path goes north and south.

2038.name: A Trodden Path

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Hut.

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Hut.

2038.description:
The path ends at a wall of grey rock rising from the trees, in which a
rift gapes, a crooked mouth breathing out a warm stink of smoke and
sulphur. Huts crouch to the east and west with their doors turned toward
it. Black stains streak the rock above the opening where fumes have
licked it. The path runs back south, and the rift leads north.

2039.name: A Small Hut

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2039.description:
A hut kept by someone who values order: the sleeping mats are rolled,
the cooking pots hang by size, and there is not a speck of dust on the
sword rack. Faint daylight comes in at the door and through a slit in
the wall that faces the rift. The great curved horn of some beast hangs
over the doorway. The only exit is west.

2040.name: A Small Hut

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

2040.description:
The walls of this hut bristle with the pelts of wolves and bears, so
that the whole room smells strongly of musk and old blood. A bone-
handled knife is stuck in a stump beside a bowl of stale stew. Feathers
lie drifted across the trodden floor where a pallet has been torn apart.
The only way out is east, through the low door to the path.

2041.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies A Trodden Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2041.description:
The rift opens into a cave of dark grey rock, the roof lost in gloom and
the floor sloping gently down. Soot has blackened the walls near the
entrance, and a few guttering torches burn in iron brackets driven into
cracks. Drips ring in the dark ahead. The smell of smoke is stronger,
and beneath it lies something sweeter, like incense.

2042.name: The Wandering Caves

west.description: To the west lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2042.description:
A pool of still black water fills the floor of this cave, so dark and
clear that the stalactites above hang twice, once in the roof and once
reflected. Drips fall at intervals, and each ring spreads outward in a
long, slow circle. The walls are glossy with damp, and the air is thick
with the smell of wet stone.

2043.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies A Small Hut.

east.description: To the east lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2043.description:
Bones are heaped in a low alcove in the wall of this cave, gnawed and
cracked for the marrow, some of them far too large for a deer. A tally
of long scratches runs across the rock in groups of five. The roof
presses low, and the floor is greasy underfoot. The smoke smell is faint
here, the animal smell strong.

2044.name: The Wandering Caves

west.description: To the west lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2044.description:
The cave narrows to a crawl where the roof comes down to within a yard
of the floor, polished by the shoulders of those who have squeezed
through. Soot from passing torches has painted a long black streak along
the rock. Every sound is swallowed. The stone is cold and the dark
absolute outside the reach of your light.

2045.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2045.description:
Patches of pale fungus glow on the walls of this cave in sickly greens
and whites, giving just enough light to show the shapes of things. The
floor is soft with mould and bat droppings, and the smell is rich and
sweetish. Threads of rootlets hang from cracks in the roof like grey
hair. The air is warm and wet.

2046.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

2046.description:
A broad cave where dry grass has been laid in rows as bedding, dozens of
pallets in all, each with a soot-black cooking pot at its head. Skulls
of beasts and men sit on ledges round the walls as trophies. A heap of
discarded armour rusts in one corner. The fires are low and the smoke
clings to the roof.

2047.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

2047.description:
A crack in the floor of this cave breathes out warm air with a thin
hiss, and the rock around it is crusted a bright sulphur yellow. Wisps
of vapour curl upward and cling to the stalactites. The stink is eye-
watering. Streaks of orange run down the walls where the hot water has
dried.

2048.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

north.description: To the north lies The Wandering Caves.

2048.description:
The walls of this dry cavern are covered with paintings in red ochre:
dragons in flight, columns of armoured warriors, and the great flame of
a burning city. Handprints dot the rock around the pictures, some small,
some clawed. The floor is swept clean of rubble. Dust hangs motionless
in the dull torchlight.

extra_descs.paintings ochre dragons:
The paintings are old, older than the camp, and the burning city in them
is not drawn with any hatred, only with a kind of awe.

2049.name: The Wandering Caves

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

2049.description:
A ledge runs along a drop here, and a bridge of rope and rotting planks
spans a gap in the rock, creaking in a draught from below. Far beneath,
water moves with a hollow, murmuring sound. The ledge is slick with
damp. Stalagmites rise from the shelf like a row of broken teeth.

2050.name: The Wandering Caves

north.description: To the north lies The Draconian Shrine.

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

east.description: To the east lies The Wandering Caves.

2050.description:
The cave rises in rough steps worn smooth by countless feet, ending in
an arched mouth where two iron braziers burn with a heavy red flame.
Incense smoke rolls out thick and sweet, stinging the eyes. Dragon heads
are chiselled on the rock about the arch, mouths open. To the north lies
the Draconian Shrine.

2051.name: The Wandering Caves

west.description: To the west lies The Wandering Caves.

east.description: To the east lies The Wandering Caves.

2051.description:
A rusted iron cage hangs on a chain from the roof of this cave, its door
torn open and its floor strewn with old bones. The ground slopes steeply
and loose gravel slides away underfoot. Black burns smear the rock
behind the cage. Somewhere not far off a drum is being beaten, slow and
heavy.

2052.name: The Wandering Caves

west.description: To the west lies The Wandering Caves.

2052.description:
Crystals as white as bone cover the walls of this cave, glinting in the
torchlight in long, angular spears. The floor is smooth and cold, and
the roof curves overhead like an upturned bowl. A chain of footprints
leads across the dust and stops at the centre of the floor. Your breath
hangs before your face in the chill.

2053.name: The Draconian Shrine

south.description: To the south lies The Wandering Caves.

2053.description:
The shrine is a vaulted cavern of black rock, its walls carved with
scales so that the whole chamber seems the belly of some vast sleeping
beast. An altar of black stone stands before an idol of a five-headed
dragon, its jewelled eyes glittering in the light of iron braziers.
Smoke rises from the bowls and gathers beneath the roof in a slow,
shifting cloud. The air is thick with incense and the smell of burnt
offerings.

extra_descs.idol dragon five-headed statue:
The idol has five heads, each of a different colour of stone, and the
eyes of all of them are red glass. Its claws are worn bright by the
touch of the faithful.

2054.name: The Large Clearing

west.description: To the west lies A Trodden Path.

2054.description:
A great open parade ground lies here, ringed with stumps and tall pines,
the earth stamped flat as a threshing floor. Racks of practice spears
and wooden swords stand in rows along the rim. At the centre rises a
scarred post for punishments, and beside it a platform of logs from
which a commander can address the ranks. The sky overhead is grey with
smoke, and the only path out is west.

2055.name: In the light

east.description: To the east lies A Trodden Path.

2055.description:
A bright glade where the pines have been felled so that the sun falls
full on the bare earth. After the smoke of the camp the light is
startling, and warm stones lie in the sun, flat and smooth as
hearthstones. Dry grass crackles at the edges. A path leads back east to
the shade and the split boulder.

650200.name: baaz draconian soldier brass
650200.long_desc: A brass-scaled draconian soldier stalks the path, hissing and flexing his clawed hands.
650200.description:
A stocky, lizard-faced soldier whose body is covered in dull brass
scales, with leathery wings folded tight against his back. His yellow
eyes follow you with greedy menace, and he wears a ragged tabard of
black and red.

650201.name: kapak draconian bronze archer
650201.long_desc: A bronze-scaled draconian archer crouches at the edge of the huts, an arrow already on the string.
650201.description:
A lean, hunched warrior in bronze scale, with a long snout and narrow
gleaming eyes. A short bow is slung across his shoulder and a curved
dagger glints at his belt, its edge dark with something sticky.

650202.name: cave spider giant pale
650202.long_desc: A giant cave spider the colour of old bone clings to the rock, its fangs dripping.
650202.description:
The spider's body is the size of a sheepdog, pale and swollen, with
eight pale eyes that shimmer like wet pebbles. It moves in sudden stabs
over the rock and dangles on threads from the roof.

650203.name: sivak draconian warrior silver
650203.long_desc: A silver-scaled draconian champion strides across the ground with a cruel, drawn blade.
650203.description:
Taller than any of the lesser kind, he is armoured in silver scale and
bears wings that carry him in great leaping glides. His eyes are cold
and keen, and his snout is scarred by many fights.

650204.name: bozak draconian shaman mage priest
650204.long_desc: A bozak draconian shaman mutters at the rock, fire licking about his talons.
650204.description:
A gaunt draconian in robes of smoke-grey, wings tattered at the edges
and a crown of small horns. His claws crackle with a sullen red light,
and the air about him is hot and tastes of cinders.

650205.name: skarrag chief guard draconian captain
650205.long_desc: Skarrag the chief guard stands in the lamplit hut, hand on the haft of a spiked flail.
650205.description:
A massive draconian with scales of scarred, dull gold and a ragged crest
down his spine. A necklace of fangs rattles at his throat, and he fights
with a spiked flail and the cruel patience of a veteran who has never
been beaten.

650206.name: zhaarok high priest draconian
650206.long_desc: Zhaarok, the draconian high priest, stands before the altar in robes of red and black, chanting.
650206.description:
An ancient draconian in robes the colour of dried blood, his scales gone
to a dull black and his wings scarred where they were once burnt. A
staff topped with a dragon's skull is in his claws, and when he turns
his terrible stare on you the braziers flare as if in answer.

750200.name: draconian scimitar curved notched
750200.room_desc: A notched, curved scimitar lies here.
750200.description: A heavy scimitar with a brass hilt moulded to fit a clawed hand. The edge is notched with use and stained dark.

750201.name: silver war helm draconian horned
750201.room_desc: A horned silver war-helm lies here.
750201.description: A helm of silvered scales, shaped to fit a long snout and fitted with a pair of swept-back horns. Heavy but well made.

750202.name: chief golden scale mail armour
750202.short_desc: the chief guard's golden scale mail
750202.room_desc: A coat of golden scale mail lies here.
750202.description: Overlapping scales of dull gold riveted to a thick leather jerkin, scarred by many blows and well kept. It is heavy but turns a blade well.

750203.name: amulet dragon black stone zhaarok
750203.room_desc: A black stone amulet in the shape of a dragon lies here.
750203.description: A dragon carved in black stone, cold to the touch, hanging from a chain of blackened links. A faint murmur of prayers seems to cling to it.

750204.name: dragonclaw dagger curved claw
750204.short_desc: a dagger made from a dragon's claw
750204.room_desc: A curved dagger made from a great claw lies here.
750204.description: The curved claw of some great lizard has been ground to a point and mounted in a hilt of blackened iron. It is surprisingly light, and wickedly sharp.
